Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

To optimize our supply chain by consolidating the entire fastener kit with a single partner as intended, we are ready to commit to a significantly higher volume over a multi-year term to secure a bundled discount that reflects this strategic simplification.

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 units per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. That is about EUR 188,700 a year, around 5 times our current business with you. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed +1.7% from 2025-12 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-12, idx:LCI-C@2026-06). Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed +0.9% from 2026-02 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2026-02, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08). Our recent orders for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc were at 12.46 per 100 (po:4500014328-10, po:4500014403-10, po:4500014475-10).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.94, payment_days 90, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.86, payment_days 14, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.91, payment_days 60, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Although we have verified the index data and historical pricing for the specific hex bolt, these records do not fully represent the cost structure of the complete bundled kit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

We welcome your strategic decision to consolidate the fastener kit with us and your commitment to a 24-month volume. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current offer is a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. In return for the 14-day payment terms and the 24-month contract, we can revise our offer to a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
